title: Google Home's latest update brings interactive storytelling with Gemini and support for way more cameras
content_html:
Published Aug 5, 2026, 6:38 PM EDT

Timi is the news and deals reporter for Android Police, who has been reporting on technology since 2008. He has worked in tech retail and also the IT space, providing hardware and software support, which gives him a unique perspective on the tech that he covers. This allows him to effectively break down complex subjects into easy-to-read pieces that even casual readers can enjoy. Before joining Android Police, he was a news writer for XDA, where he eventually transitioned to covering deals. He also worked as an editor and reporter for Neowin, where he covered news and attended major tech events like CES. He also reviewed phones, tablets, PC products, and other devices. In addition, he also created video content for the Neowin YouTube channel.

Sign in to your Android Police account

A new Google Home update just launched, providing users with more features, major bug fixes, and access to new features directly tied to Gemini. If you're someone who relies on Google Home, you're going to want to grab this latest update (via Android Authority).

There's a lot to unpack here

This is one of those updates that just has so much, that it will probably take quite some time for most users to experiment with everything that's new. Perhaps one of the more exciting features of the update is "Interactive Storytime with Gemini." Users will now be able to "co-create custom adventures on the fly, interrupt the narrative to change the plot mid-scene, or remix classic fairy tales together in real-time."

This is a great way to have some fun with your kids, making custom stories about them whenever you feel like it. In addition, Google Home has made improvements to timers and alarms, making it easier to get the results you want, when you ask for them. Furthermore, Google Home also "now understands how you prefer to set your time, whether you use a 12-hour or 24-hour clock."

The update also delivers new bug fixes:

  • Distinct Chime for turn off or down Actions: Turning off a device or dimming a light now plays a soft, descending tone different from the normal upward sound, confirming your command with a sound that matches the mood.
  • Google Home Speaker light ring: Fixed an issue where Google Home Speaker’s light ring remained on with a pulsing LED even after routines finished executing. This also prevents lingering lights in dark rooms or during relaxation sound loops.
  • [Resolved] Spotify outage: There was a brief outage with Spotify on Monday July 27th that was quickly resolved on the same day.

The update also expands Google Home automation support to new regions and adds support for new languages. More cameras will now be supported with Google Home, with additions from big brands like Eufy, Wyze, Tapo, Reolink, and more. There are a lot of changes here, so we've listed them all verbatim below from the Google Home support page.

  • New quick ‘Save Clip’ shortcut: New shortcut makes it easier to download event recordings straight from your camera view. Just tap the 3-dot menu next to any recording in your event list to save it instantly by clicking on the download shortcut. (Tip: Want a custom clip length? Use the menu button while playing or scrolling the timeline!).
  • AI event descriptions (Home Premium Advanced): Subscribers can now read helpful, auto-generated event summaries right inside the full-screen camera view so you know what happened at a glance.
  • Smarter camera view defaults: The main camera view now opens directly to your timeline or event list so you can jump straight to important moments.
  • Auto full-screen in landscape: Rotate your phone sideways while watching a live feed or recording in portrait to automatically jump into full-screen view.
  • Longer live streaming: Watch your Nest camera live streams for longer without interruptions, thanks to under-the-hood stability improvements.
  • Quick stream reconnects (Android): If your Wi-Fi or cellular connection drops, the app instantly notices and gives you a quick retry button to get your live view back up fast.
  • Smoother feed scrolling (Android): Enjoy a smoother experience when scrolling through your camera list—video feeds now pause and resume seamlessly as you move down the page.
  • Smoother camera history scrolling (iOS): Fixed a camera timeline issue on iOS where manually scrolling back to live video could occasionally get stuck on an empty historical frame
  • Accurate battery status indicators (iOS): Resolved an issue where live streaming cameras with unreadable battery levels would erroneously display a dead battery icon.
  • Performance improvements for Samsung phones: Fixed issue where camera audio stream used call volume instead of media volume.

And one final update brings improved error handling for "Works with Google Home smart locks." This will show "clearer notification alerts during lock and unlock operations." If you're a Google Home user, this is one update that you need to get.

sentences.en: Longer live streaming: Watch your Nest camera live streams for longer without interruptions, thanks to under-the-hood stability improvements.

blocks.html_en: • Quick stream reconnects (Android): If your Wi-Fi or cellular connection drops, the app instantly notices and gives you a quick retry button to get your live view back up fast.

sentences.en: Quick stream reconnects (Android): If your Wi-Fi or cellular connection drops, the app instantly notices and gives you a quick retry button to get your live view back up fast.

blocks.html_en: • Smoother feed scrolling (Android): Enjoy a smoother experience when scrolling through your camera list—video feeds now pause and resume seamlessly as you move down the page.

sentences.en: Smoother feed scrolling (Android): Enjoy a smoother experience when scrolling through your camera list—video feeds now pause and resume seamlessly as you move down the page.

blocks.html_en: • Smoother camera history scrolling (iOS): Fixed a camera timeline issue on iOS where manually scrolling back to live video could occasionally get stuck on an empty historical frame

sentences.en: Smoother camera history scrolling (iOS): Fixed a camera timeline issue on iOS where manually scrolling back to live video could occasionally get stuck on an empty historical frame
sentences.zh: 更流畅的相机历史记录滚动 (iOS)：修复了 iOS 上的相机时间轴问题，该问题导致手动滚动回实时视频有时可能会卡在空历史帧上

blocks.html_en: • Accurate battery status indicators (iOS): Resolved an issue where live streaming cameras with unreadable battery levels would erroneously display a dead battery icon.

sentences.en: Accurate battery status indicators (iOS): Resolved an issue where live streaming cameras with unreadable battery levels would erroneously display a dead battery icon.

blocks.html_en: • Performance improvements for Samsung phones: Fixed issue where camera audio stream used call volume instead of media volume.

发布于 2026 年 8 月 5 日下午 6:38（美国东部时间）

Timi 是 Android Police 的新闻和交易记者，自 2008 年以来一直在报道技术。 他曾在科技零售和 IT 领域工作，提供硬件和软件支持，这使他对他所涵盖的技术有独特的视角。 这使他能够有效地将复杂的主题分解成易于阅读的文章，即使是普通读者也能喜欢。 在加入 Android Police 之前，他是 XDA 的新闻撰稿人，最终转而报道交易。 他还曾担任 Neowin 的编辑和记者，报道新闻并参加 CES 等重大科技活动。 他还审查了手机、平板电脑、电脑产品和其他设备。 此外，他还为 Neowin YouTube 频道制作了视频内容。

登录您的 Android Police 帐户

刚刚推出的新 Google Home 更新为用户提供了更多功能、主要错误修复以及与 Gemini 直接相关的新功能。 如果您依赖 Google Home，您会想要获取此最新更新（通过 Android Authority）。

这里有很多东西需要解压

这是更新内容如此之多的更新之一，大多数用户可能需要相当长的时间才能尝试所有新内容。 也许更新中更令人兴奋的功能之一是“与双子座的互动故事时间”。 用户现在将能够“即时共同创建自定义冒险，中断叙事以改变场景中的情节，或者实时重新混合经典童话故事。”

这是与孩子一起享受乐趣的好方法，只要您愿意，就可以为他们制作定制故事。 此外，Google Home 对计时器和闹钟进行了改进，让您可以在需要时更轻松地获得所需的结果。 此外，Google Home 还“现在可以了解您喜欢如何设置时间，无论您使用 12 小时制还是 24 小时制”。

此更新还修复了新的错误：

用于关闭或关闭操作的独特提示音：关闭设备或调暗灯光现在会播放与正常向上声音不同的柔和的向下音调，以与心情相匹配的声音确认您的命令。 Google Home 扬声器灯环：修复了即使在例程执行完毕后，Google Home 扬声器的灯环仍保持亮起并带有脉冲 LED 的问题。 这还可以防止黑暗房间中或放松声音循环期间出现挥之不去的灯光。 [已解决] Spotify 中断：7 月 27 日星期一，Spotify 出现短暂中断，但当天很快得到解决。

此次更新还将 Google Home 自动化支持扩展到新地区，并增加了对新语言的支持。 现在，Google Home 将支持更多摄像头，其中包括 Eufy、Wyze、Tapo、Reolink 等大品牌的新增功能。 这里有很多更改，因此我们在下面从 Google Home 支持页面逐字列出了它们。

新的快速“保存剪辑”快捷方式：新快捷方式使您可以更轻松地直接从相机视图下载事件录制内容。 只需点击事件列表中任何录音旁边的三点菜单，即可通过单击下载快捷方式立即保存它。 （提示：想要自定义剪辑长度？ 在播放或滚动时间线时使用菜单按钮！）。 AI 事件描述（家庭高级版）：订阅者现在可以在全屏摄像头视图中阅读有用的自动生成的事件摘要，以便您一目了然地知道发生了什么。 更智能的相机视图默认设置：主相机视图现在直接打开到您的时间线或事件列表，以便您可以直接跳转到重要时刻。 自动横屏全屏：观看直播或竖屏录制时，横向旋转手机即可自动跳至全屏视图。 更长时间的直播：得益于底层稳定性的改进，您可以更长时间地不间断地观看 Nest 摄像机的直播。 快速流重新连接 (Android)：如果您的 Wi-Fi 或蜂窝网络连接断开，应用程序会立即注意到并为您提供快速重试按钮，以快速恢复实时视图。 更流畅的源滚动 (Android)：滚动浏览摄像机列表时享受更流畅的体验 - 现在，当您向下移动页面时，视频源可以无缝暂停和恢复。 更流畅的摄像机历史滚动 (iOS)：修复了 iOS 上的摄像机时间线问题，手动滚动回实时视频有时可能会卡在空历史帧上准确的电池状态指示器 (iOS)：解决了电池电量无法读取的实时流媒体摄像机会错误地显示电量耗尽图标的问题。 三星手机的性能改进：修复了相机音频流使用通话音量而不是媒体音量的问题。

最后一项更新改进了“与 Google Home 智能锁配合使用”的错误处理。 这将显示“锁定和解锁操作期间更清晰的通知警报”。 如果您是 Google Home 用户，这是您需要获取的更新。
